01 · About

Code and craft, same project.

I'm a Computation & Media student who splits time between building playable systems and building believable worlds — writing the physics and scoring logic for a game in Python one day, then UV-unwrapping and lighting a hard-surface asset in Blender the next.

Outside the editor, I run camera and direct coverage for my university's media club — so I think about framing, pacing and audience the same way whether it's a level or a lens.

Currently deep in Unreal Engine 5: level design, lighting, and Blueprint scripting — looking for an internship where technical rigour and artistic instinct get to work on the same problem.
